newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group boosts stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group boosts stake in unit.

text.p: Berjaya Group Bhd said on Friday that it has acquired an additional 35.19 million shares representing 12.56 percent of subsidiary Berjaya Singer Bhd for a total of 173.27 million ringgit.
In a statement, Berjaya Group said its total interest in Berjaya Singer after the purchases is 78.90 percent comprising 221.02 million shares.
It said the purchases of the shares are consistent with its policy "to increase its shareholdings in its subsidiaries when such shares are available at reasonable prices".

Berjaya Group's businesses include management services, property investment and rental of property. Berjaya Singer markets and sells consumer durables, household and personal products and other items.
